statement: A Raft commit/apply slice that makes no durable progress during node shutdown surfaces as a typed, owner-handled outcome on every consumer path; no commitEntries invocation can escape as a process-level unhandledRejection.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Root cause (corroborated by two independent repros): LiferaftProvider.shutdownNode (src/raft/liferaft-provider.js:305-310) calls raftNode.end() synchronously without awaiting raft._commitApplyTail; a queued commitAndApplyEntries slice landing after the replica DB closes gets [] from commitAndApplySlice (src/raft/sqlite-log-adapter-batch-api.js:33-35, !isOpen()), and liferaft-commit-scheduler.js:94-96 throws NO_DURABLE_PROGRESS on a promise no caller observes (base liferaft fires commitEntries without awaiting at @markwylde/liferaft/index.js:335/343; the async data-listener promise is discarded by EventEmitter). Process-level unhandledRejection during any node departure with in-flight replication; ~1-in-2 repro in three-node teardowns (multi-node-raft-replication and node-join-replica-activation) before test-side mitigation. Fix shape: drain/await the commit-apply tail (or attach a typed shutdown-scope handler) in shutdownNode before end().
